description: This file defines the data structures, enums, and function prototypes for handling rbusValue_t objects, which represent a variant data type used within the rbus communication framework. It includes API declarations for initializing, copying, comparing, setting, and retrieving various data types stored inside rbusValue_t, as well as utility functions for string conversion and debugging. The file serves as the interface for managing rbus values, including type definitions, memory management, and data accessors.
